spans.s: श्वक् vt. 1Ā (pres. श्वंकते) To go, to move.
ष्वक्क् vt. 1Ā (pres. ष्वक्कते) to go, to move.
श्वच् vt. or vi. 1Ā (pres. श्वंचते) 1. To go, to move; 2. to be opened, to be split.
श्वज् vt. 1Ā (pres. श्वजते) To go, to move.
श्वठ् vt. or vi. 10U (pres. श्वठयति-ते in the first two senses and श्वाठयति-ते, श्वंठयति-ते in the last sense) 1. To go, to move; 2. to adorn, to accomplish; 3. to speak ill.
स्वठ् vt. 10U (pres. स्वठयति-ते) 1. To finish; 2. to go.
श्वन् m. (fem. शुनी) (nom. श्वा, -नौ, -नः; acc. pl. शुनः) A dog, लांगूलचालनमधश्चरणावपातं भूमौ निपत्य वदनोदरदर्शनं च । श्वा पिंडदस्य कुरुते Bhartr.ii.31.
स्वन् vi. 1P (pres. स्वनिति) 1. To sound, to make a noise, वेणवः कीचकास्ते स्युर्ये स्वनंत्यनिलोद्धताः Am.ii.4, 161; 2. to sing.
स्वन् Caus. (स्वनयति-ते) 1. to make to resound; 2. to sound; 3. to adorn; (in this sense स्वानयति).
श्वाकर्ण m. a dog’s ear.
श्वन्-क्रीडिन् m. a keeper of sporting dogs.
श्वन्-गण m. a pack of hounds.
श्वन्-गणिक m. 1. a hunter; 2. a dog-feeder.
श्वागणिक m. One who lives by keeping dogs, a dog-keeper.
श्वादंत m. a dog’s tooth.
श्वन्-धूर्त m. a jackal.
श्वन्-नर m. a currish fellow.
श्वन्-निश n. a night on which dogs bark.
श्वन्-निशा f. a night on which dogs bark.
श्वन्-पच्, -पच m. a Chaṇḍāla, Bh.V.iv.23.
श्वन्-पच्, -पच m. a Chaṇḍāla, Bh.V.iv.23.
श्वन्-पद n. a dog’s foot.
श्वापद m. 1. a beast of prey; 2. a tiger.
स्वापद m. A wild beast. Cf. श्वापद.
श्वन्-पाक m. a Chaṇḍāla.
श्वापुच्छ m.n. a dog’s tail.
श्वन्-फल n. the citron.
श्वन्-भीरु m. a jackal.
श्वन्-यूथ्य n. a pack of dogs.
श्वन्-वृत्ति f. 1. the life of a dog, सेवा श्ववृत्तिराख्याता M.iv.6; (hence) 2. servitude, श्ववृत्यां कदाचन (न जीवेत्) M.iv.4.
श्वाविध m. a porcupine.
श्वन्-व्याघ्र m. 1. a beast of prey; 2. a tiger; 3. a leopard.
श्वन्-हन् m. a hunter.
श्वभ्र् vt. or vi. 10U (pres. श्वभ्रयति-ते) 1. To go, to move; 2. to make a hole, to pierce, to bore; 3. to live in misery.
श्वभ्र n. A hole, a chasm.
श्वय m. Swelling, increase.
श्वयथु m. Swelling, intumescence.
श्वयीची f. Sickness, disease.
श्वल् vi. 1P (pres. श्वलति) To run.
श्वल्ल् vi. 1P (pres. श्वल्लति) To run.
स्वल् vt. 1P (pres. स्वलति) To go, to move.
श्वल्क् vt. 10U (pres. श्वल्कयति-ते) To tell, to narrate.
श्वशुर m. A father-in-law, a wife’s or husband’s father, M.iii.119.
स्वशुर m. father-in-law. Cf. श्वशुर.
श्वशुरक m. A father-in-law.
श्वशुर्य m. A brother-in-law, a wife’s or husband’s brother.
श्वश्रू f. A mother-in-law, a wife’s or husband’s mother, R.xiv.13.
श्वश्रू-श्वशुर m. du. mother and father-in-law.

श्वस् vi. 2P (pp. श्वस्त or श्वसित; pres. श्वसिति) 1. To respire, to breathe, to draw breath, e.g. स लोहकारभस्रेव श्वसन्नपि न जीवति; 2. to sigh, श्वसिति विहगवर्गः Rt.i.23; 3. to hiss, to snort.With आ-, 1. to recover; 2. to take courage; 3. to sigh, Bt.ix.56.With उद्-, 1. to breathe, M.iii.72; 2. to sigh, Bt.vi.120; 3. to expand, to open (as a flower); 4. to upheave.With नि-, to sigh.With निस्-, to sigh.With वि-, 1. to confide in, to put one’s trust in (generally with a loc.); 2. to be fearless, विशश्वसे पक्षिगणैः समंतात् Bt.ii.25.With समा-, to calm oneself, to take heart.
श्वस् Caus. (श्वासयति-ते) With आ-, to console, to comfort.With वि-, to inspire confidence, to cause to confide.With समा-, to encourage, to cheer up.
श्वस् ind. To-morrow, अद्य श्वः फणिनां शकुंतशिशवो दंतावलानां शशाः Bh.V.i.72; (at the beginning of compounds it has the sense of ‘future’).
श्वःश्रेयस (I) a. happy, prosperous.
श्वःश्रेयस (II) n. 1. happiness, prosperity; 2. an epithet of Brahman (n.).
श्वसन (I) m. 1. Air, wind, श्वसनचलितपल्लवाधरोष्ठे Kir.x.34, Sis.xi.21; 2. name of a demon vanquished by Indra.
श्वसन (II) n. 1. Breathing, respiration, Sis.ix.52; 2. sighing.
श्वसन-अशन m. a snake, a serpent.
श्वसन-ईश्वर m. the Arjuna tree.
श्वसन-उत्सुक m. a serpent.
श्वसित n. 1. Breathing, respiration; 2. sighing.
श्वस्तन a. (f. नी) Belonging to the morrow, future.
श्वस्तन a. (f. नी) Belonging to the morrow, future.
श्वस्त्य a. (f. स्त्या) The same as श्वस्तन q.v.
श्वस्त्य a. (f. स्त्या) The same as श्वस्तन q.v.
श्वान m. A dog.
स्वन m. Sound, noise, मनोभिरामाः शृण्वंतौ रथनेमिस्वनोन्मुखैः R.i.39.
स्वान m. Sound, noise.
श्वान-निद्रा f. a light slumber.
श्वान-वैखरी f. a term for angry snarling.
श्वास m. 1. Breathing, respiration, श्वाससाधारणानिलैः K.S.ii.42; 2. a sigh; 3. air, wind; 4. asthma.
श्वास-कास m. asthma.
श्वास-रोध m. obstruction of the breath.
श्वास-हिक्का f. a kind of hiccough.
श्वास-हेति f. sleep.
श्वासिन् m. 1. Air, wind; 2. a breathing animal, a living creature.

ष्वष्क् vt. 1Ā (pres. ष्वष्कते) to go, to move.Note. Many roots, which begin with a स् followed by a dental or a vowel except ऋ or ॠ, are given in the Dhātupāṭha as commencing with ष्. These will be found under स.
स्वस्क् vt. 1Ā (pres. स्वस्कते) To go, to move. Cf. ष्वस्क्.

स्व (I) pron. a. (f. स्वा) 1. Own, belonging to oneself, सा निंदंती स्वानि भाग्यानि बाला Sak.v.; 2. of one’s own tribe or family, न विप्रं स्वेषु तिष्ठत्सु मृतं शूद्रेण नाययेत् M.v.104; 3. natural, original, वपुरभिनवमस्याः पुष्यति स्वां न शोभाम् Sak.i.
स्व (II) m. 1. A relative, a kinsman; 2. soul.
स्व (III) m.n. Wealth, riches.

स्व (I) pron. a. (f. स्वा) 1. Own, belonging to oneself, सा निंदंती स्वानि भाग्यानि बाला Sak.v.; 2. of one’s own tribe or family, न विप्रं स्वेषु तिष्ठत्सु मृतं शूद्रेण नाययेत् M.v.104; 3. natural, original, वपुरभिनवमस्याः पुष्यति स्वां न शोभाम् Sak.i.
स्व-अक्षपाद m. a follower of the Nyāya system of philosophy.
स्व-अधिकार m. one’s own function or office, स्वाधिकारात् प्रमत्तः Megh.i.1.
स्व-अधिष्ठान n. one of the six chakras or mystical circles of the body.
स्व-अधीन a. self-dependent, in one’s own power, e.g. स्वाधीना वचनीयताऽपि हि वरं बद्धो न सेवांजलिः.
स्व-अधीन˚कुशल a. having prosperity in one’s own power, स्वाधीनकुशलाः सिद्धिमंतः Sak.i.
स्व-अधीन˚पतिका f. a woman who has control over her husband, प्रभावप्रभवं कांतं स्वाधीनपतिका यथा K.Pr.x.
स्व-अध्याय m. study of the Vedas, a sacred study, perusal of sacred books.
स्व-अनुभूति f. one’s own experience, self-enjoyment, स्वानुभूत्येकसाराय नमः शांताय तेजसे Bhartr.ii.1.
स्व-अंत n. 1. the mind; 2. a cavern.
स्व-अर्थ m. 1. self interest; 2. own meaning.
स्व-अर्थ˚पंडित a. clever in one’s own affairs.
स्व-अर्थ˚विघात m. the frustration of one’s own object.
स्व-अर्थ˚अनुमान n. a particular process of induction, (as op. to परार्थानुमान) (in logic).
स्व-आयत्त a. depending upon oneself, स्वायत्तमेकांतगुणं विधात्रा Bhartr.ii.7.
स्व-कंपन m. air, wind.
स्व-गतम् ind. to oneself, aside, (in theatrical language).
स्व-च्छंद (I) a. self-willed, wanton.
स्व-च्छंद (II) m. own fancy, own choice, independence.
स्व-च्छंदम् ind. voluntarily, wantonly, स्वच्छंदोच्छलदच्छकच्छकुहरच्छातेतरांबुच्छटा K.Pr.i.
स्व-ज (I) a. selfborn.
स्व-ज (II) m. 1. a child; 2. sweat, perspiration.
स्व-ज (III) n. blood.
स्व-जन m. a kinsman, a relative, इतः प्रत्यादेशात् स्वजनमनुगतंतुं व्यवसिता Sak.vi.
स्व-तंत्र a. self-willed, independent.
स्व-त्र m. a blind-man.
स्व-त्व n. 1. self-existence; 2. ownership (in law).
स्व-धर्म m.n. 1. own right, own duty; (See M.i.88-91); 2. one’s own religion.
स्व-धा (I) f. 1. spontaneity; 2. self-will; 3. worldly illusion; 4. the food offered to deceased ancestors, व्यपैति ददतः स्वधा M.ix.127; 5. the food of the Manes personified.
स्व-धा (II) ind. an exclamation used on presenting an oblation to the Manes, e.g. स्वाहास्वधाकाराविवर्जितानि श्मशानतुल्यानि गृहाणि तानि; (it governs a dat., e.g. पितृभ्यः स्वधा).
स्व-धा˚भुज् m. 1. a deified ancestor; 2. a deity.
स्व-परमंडल n. one’s own and an enemy’s country.
स्व-प्रकाश a. self-evident, self-luminous.
स्व-प्रयोगात् ind. by means of one’s own exertions.
स्व-भट m. one’s own warrior, body-guard.
स्व-भाव m. (own state) an essential or inherent property, natural constitution, nature, e.g. किमप्यस्ति स्वभावेन सुंदरं वाप्यसुंदरम्.

स्व-भाव˚उक्ति f. 1. spontaneous declaration; 2. a figure of speech (in rhetoric) consisting in a life-like description of any thing. It is thus defined by Danḍin- नानावस्थं पदार्थानां रूपं साक्षाद्विवृण्वती K.D.ii.8.
स्व-भाव˚ज, ˚सिद्ध a. inborn, natural.
स्व-भाव˚ज, ˚सिद्ध a. inborn, natural.
स्व-भाव˚वाद m. the doctrine that the universe was produced and is sustained by the natural and necessary action of substances according to their inherent properties.
स्व-भू m. 1. epithet of Brahman (n.); 2. of Viṣṇu.
स्व-योनि (I) a. nearly related on the mother’s side.
स्व-योनि (II) m.f. own womb, one’s own place of birth.
स्व-योनि (III) f. a sister.
स्व-रस m. proper taste or sentiment in composition.
स्व-राज् m. the supreme being.
स्वाराज् m. An epithet of Indra.
स्व-रूप (I) a. 1. handsome, posing, agreeable; 2. learned, wise.
स्व-रूप (II) n. 1. one’s own form or shape; 2. true constitution, natural character; 3. peculiar aim; 4. nature; 5. species, kind.
स्व-रूप˚असिद्धि f. a form of fallacious proof (in Nyāya phil.).
स्व-वासिनी f. a woman whether married or unmarried who continues to dwell after maturity in her father’s house.
स्व-संवृत a. self-guarded, self-covered.
स्व-संस्था f. self-possession, absorption in one’s own self.
स्व-स्थ a. 1. relying upon oneself, confident, firm; 2. contented, Sis.ii.46; 3. well, healthy, at ease, comfortable, अस्वस्थशरीरा शकुंतला Sak.iii.
स्व-स्थम् ind. composedly.
स्व-स्थान n. one’s own place, own home, e.g. नक्रः स्वस्थानमासाद्य गजेंद्रमपि कर्षति.
स्व-हस्तिका f. an axe.
स्व-हित (I) a. good for oneself.
स्व-हित (II) n. one’s own advantage, one’s own welfare.
स्वक a. (f. का) Own, one’s own.
स्वक a. (f. का) Own, one’s own.
स्वकीय a. (f. या) 1. Own; 2. of one’s own family.
स्वकीय a. (f. या) 1. Own; 2. of one’s own family.
स्वग् vt. 1P (pres. स्वंगति) To go, to move.
स्वंग m. An embrace.
स्वच्छ a. (f. च्छा) 1. White, beautiful; 2. pure, transparent, bright, विकचनवकुसुंभस्वच्छसिंदूरभासा Rt.i.24.
स्वच्छ a. (f. च्छा) 1. White, beautiful; 2. pure, transparent, bright, विकचनवकुसुंभस्वच्छसिंदूरभासा Rt.i.24.
स्वच्छ-पत्र n. talc.
स्वच्छ-मणि m. crystal.

स्वंज् vt. 1Ā (the initial स् of this root is changed into ष् after a preposition ending in इ or उ) (pres. स्वजते; caus. स्वंजयति-ते) 1. To embrace, to clasp, पर्यश्रुरस्वजत मूर्धनि चोपजघ्रौ R.xiii.70; 2. to encircle, to twist round.With परि-, to embrace, हला एत पीडितं मां परिष्वजध्वम् Vikr.i.
स्वद् (I) vt. or vi. 1Ā (pres. स्वदते or स्वादते) 1. To be pleasant to the taste, to be liked, (with a dat.), सस्वदे मुखसुरं प्रमदाभ्यः Sis.x.23; 2. to taste, to eat, to relish; 3. to please.
स्वद् (II) vt. 10U (pres. स्वादयति-ते) To sweeten, to make sweet.With आ-, to taste, to eat, आस्वादितद्विरदशोणितशोणशोभाम् Mud.i.
स्वदन n. Eating, tasting.
स्वादन n. 1. Taste, flavour, savour; 2. tasting, eating, drinking; 3. liking, relishing, enjoyment.
स्वदित (I) a. (f. ता) Eaten, tasted.
स्वदित (II) n. An exclamation meaning ‘may it be well-tasted’ uttered at a Śrāddha after presenting the oblation of food to the Manes.
स्वदित (I) a. (f. ता) Eaten, tasted.
स्वधिति m.f. An axe.
स्वधिती f. An axe.
स्वन-उत्साह m. a rhinoceros.
स्वनि m. Sound, noise.
स्वनित (I) a. (f. ता) Sounded, sounding, making a noise.
स्वनित (II) n. The noise of thunder, thunder-clap.
स्वनित (I) a. (f. ता) Sounded, sounding, making a noise.
स्वनिक m. One who clasps his hands.

स्वप् vi. 2P (pp. सुप्त; pres. स्वपिति; pass. सुप्यते; desid. सुषुप्सति) (sometimes also 1U (pres. स्वपति-ते) 1. To sleep, to fall asleep, to go to bed, तां कस्यांचिद्भवनवलभौ सुप्तपारवितायाम् Megh.i.38, R.xii.50; 2. to lie down, to recline, to repose.With अव-, प्र- or सम्-, to sleep, तत्प्रसुप्तभुजगेंद्रभीषणं वीक्ष्य R.xi.44.

स्वप्न m. 1. Sleep, sleeping, रसातलादिवोन्मग्नं शेषं स्वप्नाय शार्ङ्गिणः R.xii.70; 2. dream, dreaming, स्वप्नो नु माया नु मतिभ्रमो नु Sak.vi., दृष्टः स्वप्ने कितव रमयन् कामपि त्वं मयेति Megh.ii.48; 3. indolence, sleepiness.
स्वप्न-अवस्था f. state of dreaming.
स्वप्न-उपम a. 1. resembling a dream; 2. transitory, evanescent.
स्वप्न-दोष m. pollutio nocturna.
स्वप्न-धीगम्य a. perceptible by the intellect (only) in a state of sleep like abstraction, M.xii.122.
स्वप्न-निकेतन n. a sleeping room, bed-chamber.
स्वप्न-प्रपंच m. the illusions of sleep, the world as represented in a dream.
स्वप्न-विचार m. interpretation of dreams.
स्वप्न-शील a. sleepy, drowsy.
स्वप्न-सृष्टि f. the creation of dreams or illusions in sleep.
स्वप्नज् xxx Sleepy, sleeping.

स्वयम् ind. 1. Self; (this word is applicable to all persons, such as myself, thyself, itself, herself, and is sometimes used emphatically with other pronouns), स्थातुं नियोक्तुर्न हि शक्यमग्रे विनाश्य रक्ष्यं स्वयमक्षतेन R.i.56, iii.45; 2. by oneself, spontaneously, of one’s own accord, स्वयमेवोत्पद्यंते एवंविदाः शरारसंभवाः महाकृमयः Kad.
स्वयम्-उक्ति f. 1. voluntary declaration; 2. information, deposition (in law).
स्वयम्-ग्रह m. the taking for one’s self (without leave).
स्वयम्-ग्राह a. voluntary.
स्वयम्-जात a. self-born.
स्वयम्-दत्त (I) a. self-given.
स्वयम्-दत्त (II) m. a boy who has given himself to be adopted; (one of the twelve kinds of sons recognized by Hindu law).
स्वयम्-भु m. an epithet of Brahman (m.), शंभुस्वयंभुहरयो हरिणेक्षणानाम् Bhartr.i.1.
स्वयम्-भू (I) a. self-existent.
स्वयम्-भू (II) m. 1. an epithet of Brahman (m.); 2. of Viṣṇu; 3. of Śiva; 4. of Kāla, the deity presiding over time; 5. of Kāmadeva.
स्वयम्-भुव m. 1. name of the first Manu; 2. an epithet of Brahman (m.); 3. of Śiva.
स्वायंभुव (I) a. (f. वी) 1. Relating to Brahman (m.); 2. descended from Brahman (m.).
स्वायंभुव (II) m. An epithet of the first Manu [as being a son of Brahman (m.)].
स्वयम्-वर m. a choice-marriage.
स्वयम्-वरा f. a virgin who chooses a husband for herself.
स्वर् vt. 10U (pres. स्वरयति-ते) To find fault, to blame, to censure.

स्वर् ind. 1. Heaven, paradise, छायेव या स्वर्जलधेर्जलेषु Sis.iii.35, Nal.iii.1; 2. the heaven of Indra and the temporary abode of the virtuous after death; 3. the sky, ether; 4. the space between the sun and the polar star; 5. a mystical word pronounced in daily prayers. See under व्याहृति.
स्वर्-आपगा, -गंगा, -सिंधु f. 1. the celestial Ganges; 2. the milky way.
स्वर्-आपगा, -गंगा, -सिंधु f. 1. the celestial Ganges; 2. the milky way.
